title: Personalized Agent-based Image Enhancement
usage: Hello, everyone.

title: Project background
usage: Personalized image retouching should reflect individual preferences.

title: Existing methods and our core idea
usage: AdaInt and RSFNet can require user- or expert-specific training.

title: Project goals and achievements
usage: Our three goals are automatic retouching without instructions, adaptation to unseen users without fine-tuning, and multiple editing candidates.

title: User stories and functional requirements
usage: FR-01 uses the current image and history for automatic enhancement.

title: Acceptance criteria and constraints
usage: Acceptance checks map to all three requirements: predict without instructions or the query target; adapt using eight historical pairs and no weight update; and generate multiple candidates.

title: Modelling user preferences
usage: Early image-similarity retrieval achieved approximately 30% accuracy.

title: Overall system architecture
usage: Stage 1 learns a low-dimensional retouching representation from original and expert-edited images.

title: Stage 1 · Retouching encoder and decoder
usage: The encoder receives the original, target and pixel-wise difference: nine channels in total.

title: Understanding the retouching space
usage: The retouching space is continuous and directional.

title: Stage 2 · Transformer-based conditioning
usage: Eight historical pairs provide image features and edit vectors.

title: Conditional Flow and candidate generation
usage: The conditional flow learns an invertible mapping between retouching vectors and a Gaussian base.

title: Testing strategy and quality assurance
usage: We test reconstruction, prediction quality, unseen-user generalization, conditioning ablations, candidate coverage and computational cost.

title: Datasets and evaluation protocol
usage: FiveK contains 5,000 originals and edits from five experts.

title: Test cases and requirement coverage
usage: The nine checks are grouped by requirement.

title: Retouching space reconstruction evaluation
usage: Reconstruction reached 28.5 dB on FiveK and 28.2 dB on PPSD.

title: Quantitative results on FiveK
usage: FiveK mean Top-1 PSNR was 23.562 dB.

title: Comparison with existing methods
usage: Our reported FiveK and PPSD results provide context against existing methods.

title: Ablation studies
usage: The complete model achieved 23.5 dB.

title: Multimodal evaluation and test limitations
usage: Multiple sampled candidates improve Best-of-K target coverage.

title: Discipline knowledge, implementation and tools
usage: The system combines convolutional image encoding, learned LUTs, Transformer conditioning and Conditional Normalizing Flow, implemented with Python, PyTorch and CUDA.

title: Client feedback and architecture evolution
usage: We explored semantic controls, dynamic grouping, memory, and similarity retrieval before adopting conditional density modelling.

title: Project management and collaboration
usage: Our team used GitHub for version control and collaboration, and Zoom and WeChat for communication.

title: Individual contributions
usage: The nine members contributed across research, implementation, evaluation, presentation and coordination.

title: Reflections, limitations and conclusion
usage: Our contribution is modelling a distribution of edits rather than one fixed output.
